nodes.label: EmobilizeApp
nodes.rationale: The single activity MainActivity mounts EmobilizeApp. AuthScreen and ExpandableReminderCard exist in code but EmobilizeApp does not mount them.

nodes.label: Application shell
nodes.rationale: Three layers are always present: a top bar with an empty left side and a 44 dp gear (content description Settings), the tab body (TasksScreen or CalendarScreen), and BottomDock. The gear closes the radial menu and opens Settings. The initial tab is Tasks. Switching tabs closes the radial menu and clears the calendar block selection. Entering Calendar while Update is pending cancels Update, because Update does not exist on Calendar. Dock background uses navBg.

nodes.label: System back order
nodes.rationale: System back dismisses the topmost layer first: Settings, then the Add card, then the calendar form, then the task edit sheet, then the radial menu, then cancels the block selection and any pending Edit, Delete, or Update.

nodes.label: In-memory repositories
nodes.rationale: Tasks, calendar blocks, categories, and settings stay in memory through repositories and are lost when the process dies. Initial samples are in data/repository/SampleData.kt. Visible UI copy is English.

nodes.label: TasksScreen
nodes.rationale: File ui/tasks/TasksScreen.kt. Title My tasks. State lives in TasksViewModel. A selection banner appears only while radial Update, Edit, or Delete is waiting for a card. Cards cannot be tapped unless an action is pending; unselected cards dim to alpha 0.6. The bottom action button appears only after one card is selected.

nodes.label: TasksViewModel
nodes.rationale: Owns Tasks screen state. Saving settings reloads tasks and the schedule after writing categories and AppSettings.

nodes.label: Task sections
nodes.rationale: Non-empty groups are To-do, In progress, and Done. Done is hidden when Settings Show completed tasks is off. Empty copy is No tasks in this view. The counter is completed visible tasks, a slash, then visible tasks, computed from data (shape 2 / 8), not fixed text. Inside To-do and In progress, order uses deadlineRank; Done is not re-sorted.

nodes.label: Task date filters
nodes.rationale: All, Today, Tomorrow, Later. The active chip uses background. All includes unscheduled tasks. Today, Tomorrow, and Later: a task without a time range follows filterKey; a task with a range matches when the range covers that day. Later means the range end date is still after tomorrow. A task with no date appears only in All.

nodes.label: Task card
nodes.rationale: Name wraps to at most two lines; a completed task is struck through and dimmer. Priority badge Low, Medium, or High only if priority exists. A 4 dp category color bar only if category exists. Date and time on the right only if a deadline or range exists. Overdue time, only for a Today task that has a time and is not Done, uses the high-priority color; otherwise time uses primary. A multi-day range writes start -> end for the dates and start -> end for the times.

nodes.label: Tasks radial actions
nodes.rationale: Add opens AddTaskCard and resets the draft as a Task. Update shows Select a card to update status, then Progress or Done under Set status. Edit shows Select a card to edit, then Edit task opens TaskFormSheet. Delete shows Select a card to delete, then Delete task removes the task. Cancel on the banner clears the action and the selection.

nodes.label: AddTaskCard
nodes.rationale: Only from the Tasks tab. The card sits on modalBg. Title focuses immediately, placeholder Title. Three unlabeled 44 dp icons (accessibility labels remain): Category, Priority, Schedule; the same icon closes that panel. The same category or priority chip clears the value. Schedule is Deadline or Time range; tapping the active mode turns schedule off. Deadline help: Date and time are optional. Invalid range: End time must be after start time. Add task is 44 dp, corner lg, primary fill, bold, and muted while the title is empty. A filled valid form saves and closes; an invalid time range opens Schedule and does not save. Close, an outside tap, or back discards. Starting category and priority follow Settings and may be empty.

nodes.label: TaskFormSheet
nodes.rationale: Sheet title Edit Task, save label Save Changes. Outside tap, the close mark, or back discards. Fields: name placeholder Task name..., category chips that do not clear on a second tap, priority, and Schedule as Deadline or Time range. A deadline date is required to save; time is optional (Time is optional). Invalid range shows End time must be after start time. Save Changes enables only when the name is filled and any included schedule is valid, then calls updateTask on the same id.

nodes.label: updateTask
nodes.rationale: Save Changes on the task edit sheet writes the same task id.

nodes.label: deadlineRank
nodes.rationale: Sort key used inside To-do and In progress. The Done group is not reordered by it.

nodes.label: CalendarScreen
nodes.rationale: File ui/calendar/CalendarScreen.kt. Month arrows use content descriptions Previous month and Next month. The title pattern is MMMM yyyy in the US locale. Segments are Month, Week, and Day. The initial view follows Settings; the app default is Week. Week start follows Settings, Monday or Sunday, default Monday. The selected date and visible month are remembered with rememberSaveable for the composable lifetime.

nodes.label: Month view
nodes.rationale: Grid of the visible month. Single-letter weekday names in the US locale. Cells outside the month are empty. A small dot marks a day that has a task or block. Today has a ring. The selected day is filled with primary. The selected day's agenda sits under the grid.

nodes.label: Week view
nodes.rationale: Seven days of the active date's week, short weekday names, a dot when the day has items. Tapping a day changes the agenda. The header month does not move just because the selected day changes.

nodes.label: Day view
nodes.rationale: Full weekday name and date number, with Previous day and Next day arrows. There is no grid; the agenda fills the remaining screen.

nodes.label: Day agenda
nodes.rationale: A vertical list, not an hour grid. Order is ascending start time. Items with no time sort as 48 and sit at the bottom. An empty day reads Nothing scheduled.

nodes.label: Time block card
nodes.rationale: Shows the block title, a line starting with Regular Schedule then the category name, start to end times, and a category color bar on the left.

nodes.label: Calendar task card
nodes.rationale: A task is placed on a day by taskOccursOn: the deadline date, or a date inside the range. The card shows the title, EventType (Event, Task, or Regular Schedule), category if present, priority if present, and a time label that may be a clock time, a time range, or a date.

nodes.label: taskOccursOn
nodes.rationale: Decides whether a task falls on a calendar day: a single deadline date, or any date inside its range.

nodes.label: Calendar selection actions
nodes.rationale: Update is not used on Calendar: the Update wedge is hidden, and a leftover Update is cancelled on entry. Add opens a new CalendarFormSheet with initial type Event. Edit shows Select a calendar item to edit; a task opens the form filled with that task, and a block opens a locked Regular Schedule form with the block date and start and end. Delete shows Select a calendar item to delete, then Delete calendar item. Without Edit or Delete, tapping a task card does nothing, while tapping a block still toggles block selection. Unselected cards dim while selection mode is active. Cancel clears the task selection, the block selection, and the pending action.

nodes.label: confirmAction
nodes.rationale: Deletes a selected calendar task. A selected block is not deleted through this path.

nodes.label: deleteSelectedBlock
nodes.rationale: Deletes the selected calendar block after Delete calendar item.

nodes.label: CalendarFormSheet
nodes.rationale: File ui/tasks/CalendarFormSheet.kt. Bottom sheet with a gray handle and placeholder Add title. An outside tap or Cancel discards. On add, only Event and Regular Schedule can be chosen; Task is not offered. On edit, the type is locked to the item, including Task when the opened item is a task. The save label is Save for a new item and Save Changes for an edit. Button color follows the radial action (Add or Edit). The button stays disabled until canSubmitCalendar is true.

nodes.label: Event form
nodes.rationale: Date and Time with a date, Start, and End (the time may be empty), plus Category. Save requires a title and a date. The result is stored as a task, not an hour block.

nodes.label: Calendar task edit form
nodes.rationale: Shown only when editing an item that is already a Task. Fields are Category, Priority (Low, Medium, High), and Schedule as Deadline (Time is optional) or Time range (FROM, TO, and End time must be after start time).

nodes.label: Regular Schedule form
nodes.rationale: FROM and TO on a single date; the block editor fills the same date for start and end, with the same range validation. Save writes a TimeBlock: title, decimal hours, and category. An empty category becomes Work. A new id is the current time in milliseconds; an existing id is kept on edit.

nodes.label: canSubmitCalendar
nodes.rationale: Gate for the calendar sheet save button. The button stays disabled until this is true.

nodes.label: SettingsScreen
nodes.rationale: File ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt. A full screen above the tabs, not a sheet. Header is Back and Settings. Edits stay in a local draft. Save Changes appears only after a change and can be tapped only when every category name is valid. Back or the arrow with pending edits opens Discard changes? with Your unsaved settings changes will be lost. Discard closes Settings; Keep editing returns to the form. With no edits, back closes immediately. Save writes changed categories, then AppSettings, then reloads tasks and the schedule.

nodes.label: Theme setting
nodes.rationale: Help text Choose how Emobilize looks. Choices are System, Light, and Dark. AppSettings.themeMode: System uses the system theme, Light uses NeutralLight, Dark uses NeutralDark. The default setting is Light.

nodes.label: Task defaults
nodes.rationale: Default category help: Preselect a category when adding a task (None plus each category). Default priority help: Preselect a priority when adding a task (None, Low, Medium, High). Show completed tasks help: Keep the Done section visible on the Tasks screen.

nodes.label: Calendar settings
nodes.rationale: Default view help: Choose the view shown when you open Calendar. Chip order is Week, Day, Month. Week starts on help: Use the same first day in Month and Week views. Choices are Monday and Sunday.

nodes.label: Category editor
nodes.rationale: Copy: Edit up to 3 categories and choose a color for each. The 3 is Category.Limit. Defaults are Study, Work, and Health. A closed row shows a color dot, the name, and an edit icon (Edit plus the name). An open row has placeholder Category name and five colors. Initial ARGB use: #E76E50 Study, #2A9D90 Health, #F4A462 Work, plus #274754 and #E8C468. A name must be 1 to 24 characters and must not contain the separators U+001E and U+001F. Invalid copy is Category names must be 1–24 characters, and Save Changes disables. Categories are not added from the UI; only the name and color of the three existing slots change.

nodes.label: Category.Limit
nodes.rationale: The maximum of three editable category slots. The UI does not create additional categories.

nodes.label: Radial menu
nodes.rationale: Files ui/dock/RadialMenu.kt and ui/dock/RadialDock.kt. The center button opens the fan. Base angles and theme colors: Add at -87 degrees green, Update at 0 degrees blue, Edit at a display angle of -30 degrees on both tabs using actionEdit, Delete at 87 degrees danger. On Calendar, Update is not drawn. On Tasks, Update shifts to 30 degrees and Edit to -30 degrees. Open and close use a spring with dampingRatio 0.75 and Spring.StiffnessMediumLow. The fan grows from the hub, buttons rise from the dock, and icons rotate 90 degrees. A haptic fires when the selection changes. An outside tap or back closes the menu without choosing an action. The dock does not replace other pages; it only selects Tasks or Calendar.

nodes.label: BottomDock
nodes.rationale: Tasks tab uses a list icon and Calendar uses a date icon, with a center gap for the action button. Background is navBg. It only switches between Tasks and Calendar.

nodes.label: AuthScreen
nodes.rationale: File ui/auth/AuthScreen.kt. Present in code but not mounted: MainActivity does not create AuthViewModel and does not show the screen, and EmobilizeApp does not install it. Login (AuthPage.Login) shows title Emobilize, subtitle Log in to continue, Email, a hidden Password, Log in, and Need an account? Register. Register shows Create an account, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password, Create account, and Already have an account? Log in; back returns to Login. Success only sets signedIn on the ViewModel. There is no navigation to Tasks.

nodes.label: AuthViewModel
nodes.rationale: Produces the auth failure messages and the signedIn flag. MainActivity never creates it, and a successful sign-in does not navigate anywhere.

nodes.label: Auth error messages
nodes.rationale: Invalid name: Enter your name. Invalid email: Enter a valid email. Password under 6 characters: Use at least 6 characters. Email already registered: That email is already registered. Bad login: Email or password is incorrect. Confirm mismatch: Passwords do not match.

nodes.label: ExpandableReminderCard
nodes.rationale: File ui/notifications/ExpandableReminderCard.kt. Not imported by any screen, so its actions are not wired to storage. Collapsed it shows the logo, the label Emobilize, the task name, and a time. The due line is the fixed text Due in 30 mins followed by task.time, or Scheduled time when the time is empty. The 30 minutes is not computed from the deadline. Expanding rotates the chevron 180 degrees; the content description is Expand or Collapse. Mark as done calls onMarkDone then closes. Reschedule calls onReschedule then closes.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.rationale: domain/model/Task.kt. Fields: id, name, nullable category, deadline (empty string means no date), display time like 10:30 AM which may be empty, filterKey, nullable priority, range (dates plus start and end clocks in 09:00 form), eventType, and eventEndTime. Shared by every mounted page.

nodes.label: TimeBlock
nodes.rationale: domain/model/Calendar.kt. id, title, start, end as decimal hours, and category. Stored per LocalDate.

nodes.label: AppSettings
nodes.rationale: themeMode, defaultCalendarView, weekStart, defaultCategoryId, defaultPriority, and showCompletedTasks. Settings save writes this after the changed categories.

nodes.label: NeutralLight
nodes.rationale: Palette used when themeMode is Light. Light is the default setting.

nodes.label: NeutralDark
nodes.rationale: Palette used when themeMode is Dark.
